subject: design/contract-gate-v2
statement: The **planning-entry hard gate** lands as an additive typed amendment (`add` op) on plan-new's frozen ledger: a precondition FR requiring plan-new to call `docgate contract-gate <feature>` before it drafts, freezes, or projects any plan for a document-pipeline feature — a feature with a PRD ledger — and to refuse on any non-clean verdict (`prd:contract-gate/FR-1`, `NR-1`). A draft-born feature's planning precondition is its locked version's readiness, computed in memory (`prd:feature-draft/FR-31`, `design:feature-draft-v1`); this gate is not called for it. Contract-gate's feature-level checks run **before** plan-new's own plan-level coverage (its FR-26) and fog bounce (its FR-16) — complementary altitudes, no contradiction, so no requirement hole to bounce. The **continuous advisory surface** is a docgate CI context running the same contract-scope subset over a changed feature's contract on PRD/design PRs, with currency/link/structural defects blocking and inverse-coverage advisory (a PRD legitimately merges before its designs exist) — the severity split read from the closed-schema versioned severity-map policy (`prd:contract-gate/FR-13`, on the `pyxis-config/` surface, the plangate/codegate caps precedent).
